title: Reject Separating Contact in the Rigid-Body Impact Solver
body:
## Problem

Negative normal approach produces a negative normal impulse that attracts separating bodies. The experiment uses approaching impacts, so this defect does not alter its positive-contact shots.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add a clear input contract rejecting separating contact; zero approach produces no impulse. Write the failing regression first and preserve approaching-contact behavior and conservation tests.

## Validation

tests/unit/physics/test_impact_tangential_impulse.py and test_impact_central_contact_review.py; negative approach red then green, zero contact unchanged.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
